name: WebAbility Accessibility Widget
author: Webability

sections.description:
WebAbility Accessibility Widget is a powerful yet simple plugin that adds a comprehensive accessibility toolbar to your WordPress website. Our widget helps make your site compliant with WCAG 2.1 AA and ADA standards, ensuring equal access for all users.

Key Features

  • Easy Setup: One-click installation with automatic script generation
  • Customizable Position: Choose from 4 corner positions (bottom-right, bottom-left, top-right, top-left)
  • Pixel-Perfect Positioning: Fine-tune widget placement with offset controls
  • Domain Verification: Built-in verification system to ensure proper setup
  • Lightweight: Minimal impact on your site’s performance
  • Responsive Design: Works seamlessly on all devices
  • Privacy Focused: No tracking, no data collection

Accessibility Features

The WebAbility widget provides users with:
* Screen reader compatibility
* Keyboard navigation support
* High contrast mode
* Font size adjustment
* Color blindness support
* Seizure safe mode
* Focus highlighting
* And many more accessibility tools

Perfect For

  • Businesses ensuring ADA compliance
  • Government websites requiring WCAG standards
  • E-commerce sites improving user experience
  • Educational institutions
  • Healthcare websites
  • Any website committed to digital inclusion

External Services

This plugin connects to WebAbility.io services to provide accessibility functionality. Please review this information carefully as it involves data transmission to external services.

WebAbility API (api.webability.io)

Purpose: Domain verification to confirm your website is registered in your WebAbility account.

When it’s used: Only when you click the “Verify” button in the plugin settings.

Data sent: Your website’s domain name (e.g., yoursite.com) is sent to verify registration.

Legal basis: This verification is necessary to ensure proper service setup and prevent unauthorized usage.

WebAbility Widget Script (widget.webability.io)

Purpose: Loads the accessibility widget interface on your website’s frontend.

When it’s used: When the plugin is enabled and visitors access your website.

Data sent: The widget script is loaded directly in visitors’ browsers. The script may process visitor interactions with the accessibility features (like font size changes, contrast adjustments) locally in the browser.

Legal basis: Essential for providing the accessibility service you’ve configured.

Service Provider Information

Service Provider: WebAbility.io
Terms of Service: https://www.webability.io/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.webability.io/privacy-policy

By using this plugin, you acknowledge that your website will connect to WebAbility.io services as described above. We recommend reviewing WebAbility’s terms of service and privacy policy to understand how they handle data.

Note: This plugin is developed to work with WebAbility.io services. You must have an active account with WebAbility.io for the widget to function properly.

Support

Contact the Webability support team at support@webability.io

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect any personal data. The WebAbility widget respects user privacy and operates in compliance with GDPR and other privacy regulations.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through the WordPress plugins marketplace.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > WebAbility to configure the widget.
  4. Enable the widget and customize the position to your preference.
  5. Use the verify button to ensure your domain is properly configured.
sections.faq:
Do I need a WebAbility account?

Yes, you need to register your domain at WebAbility.io to use this widget. The plugin includes a verification system to check if your domain is properly registered.

Is the widget customizable?

Yes! You can choose from 4 corner positions and fine-tune the placement with pixel-perfect offset controls.

Does this affect my site’s performance?

No, the WebAbility widget is designed to be lightweight and loads asynchronously to minimize any impact on your site’s speed.

Is it compatible with my theme?

Yes, the WebAbility widget is designed to work with any WordPress theme as it’s positioned absolutely on the page.

Can I hide the widget for logged-in users?

Yes, there’s an option to exclude the widget from appearing for logged-in users (like administrators).

Is this GDPR compliant?

Yes, the WebAbility widget respects user privacy and doesn’t collect or track personal data.
